description: Zone-2 manifest/mascot card (Figma 588:12969): the bg gradient is driven by the user's element (ดวง→มาสคอต→ธาตุ→สีพื้น, ฟีม) and the mascot comes from the chart. Three silent-regression risks: (1) an unmapped/null element leaves the card colourless — fixed: ELEMENT_GRADIENTS map with a WOOD default when elementTh is null/unknown (ไม้ Figma-exact #91d8d2→#e0ffc4; ไฟ/ดิน/ทอง/น้ำ are Lamun's PROPOSAL, in one map, AWAIT ฟีม); (2) one of 60 varied mascots (fat/winged) visually covers the title/button — fixed: content z-10 > mascot z-1 (button renders on top, readable 100%), mascot pointer-events-none so a tap passes through; (3) missing data — element null → wood gradient, mascot 404 → hero 01.png. Teeth-proven (run-zone2-card.ts): 5 gradients match; occlusion = content z > mascot z + button clickable (winged rooster); graceful null→wood + 404→01.png; mut-button-behind (content z-0 < mascot z-1) → not-on-top → CAUGHT. verify-the-instrument: elementFromPoint can't measure this occlusion (pointer-events-none mascot is invisible to hit-testing) → the gate uses z-index, not elementFromPoint. gate_layer=visual (computed-style + z-order). Real /v2 verified @ FE b2a8df1 (default = real ดิน element + real mascot). coin: 2s float + prefers-reduced-motion guard. Did not touch Zone 1/Zone 3.
